# Minimum statement coverage for the consensus-critical packages, checked by
# cmd/coveragegate on the coverage.out that `make test` writes in the PR test job.
#
# Each minimum is the coverage these packages had in CI on 2026-10-18, rounded
# down to a whole percent, so coverage can rise but not fall. Raise a minimum when
# coverage rises. Lower one only in the pull request that causes the drop, and say
# why in that pull request.
#
# The values are CI values. A local `make test` profile reports different
# statement counts and percentages, so check a minimum against the CI
# coverage-report artifact, not against a local run.
